name: telegram-approval-resolution
description: M19 F3 a+c. Owner taps Approve on a card whose delivering adapter recorded no platform_message_id (fallback-id path): the interceptor resolves it and posts the outcome as a follow-up reply instead of leaving live buttons. The same tap's opportunistic expiry sweep stamps a separately-lapsed card terminal. Neither tap writes an inbound row or wakes a runner.
